'''Shrimp Cocktail''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance).<ref name="chestchance" /> One Shrimp Cocktail may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Shrimp Cocktail is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Shrimp Cocktail is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Shrimp Cocktail is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Shrimp Enthusiast Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt286.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
